outcome: SARS-CoV-2 positivity rate in asymptomatic women admitted for spontaneous delivery
cohort: First 100 consecutive asymptomatic women admitted for spontaneous delivery
finding: Universal testing with RT-PCR and antibody detection in asymptomatic women in labor allows for better interpretation of results and may avoid unnecessary isolation procedures.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery occurred in 94% of the cases and only 6% underwent cesarean section, always for obstetric reasons.
